title: Load literature skill for lightweight paper lookup
description: Requires lightweight single-paper lookup and paper identity verification to load literature-search before choosing retrieval tools, while keeping concrete retrieval policy delegated to the skill.
changes: Add a lightweight-mode rule: paper title/acronym/fuzzy/arXiv/DOI/URL lookup must load literature-search first.
Keep concrete retrieval tool order out of AGENTS.md.
Keep paper lookup strategy owned by the literature-search skill.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous AGENTS snapshot if the load-skill requirement causes unwanted overhead.
